title: lint: field-group-shadowed does not count the stage field the record page draws as record:path, so a group whose only member is it shows empty without a warning
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUZrkMKgGrXXe8zPGq

Filing gate: **(b) a defect read during a card's development**: an out-of-scope finding in the #35251 + #35252 os-dev report (PR #35629). **Read off the code, not reproduced on a running page.** ⛔ Not a claim. Grade is left to triage's first touch.

## What happens (read, not measured)

When the default record page draws a stage bar (`record:path`: `detectStatusField` plus the field's options, in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`), `headerDrawnFields` also hides that field from the body. `field-group-shadowed` (`packages/lint/src/validate-semantic-roles.ts`) models only the highlight strip, which after PR #35629 reads `RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX`. It does not model the stage field. A field group whose only member is the stage field therefore draws nothing on the page, and lint does not warn about it.

## Expected

The lint judges the same set of hoisted fields as `headerDrawnFields`, the stage field included, so its verdict matches the screen.

## Done when

- First step: measure. Boot an object whose status field is drawn as the stage bar and whose field group holds only that field. Confirm that the group renders empty, then confirm that `os lint --strict` passes it.
- If it reproduces: the rule counts the stage field. Add a pin, a control showing that a group with one more visible member still passes, and an ablation.

Re-check after PR #35629 merges: `git grep -n "RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX\|headerDrawnFields" origin/main -- packages/lint/src ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth`.

Dedupe: issue search for `field-group-shadowed stage field record:path` and `headerDrawnFields pathField lint` found only #35252.
